scope: Offline arithmetic, collision, contract-gate and cross-prompt old-response regression checks only.
disclosure: This is an explicitly disclosed arithmetic copy of court24-v2. The exact prefix 'An independent arithmetic exercise states: ' is added once to every original, rewrite and control; the word independent is prompt text, not a claim of an independent benchmark. Answers, formulas and classes are unchanged. Public deterministic salts and different text hashes permit a separate claim without reusing spent content. They establish neither secrecy, worldwide novelty nor absence from model training.
draft_note: Prepared as a separate candidate claim while final auditing of the prior native case remains separate. This audit does not declare the prior case complete or diagnose its storage issue. The requested 1000-per-mille oath has not been measured on these new prefixed prompts.

construction.salt_derivation: First 32 hexadecimal characters of SHA256(UTF-8("impeach/court24-v3|seed=240526|item=NN")); NN is the zero-padded item index.
construction.prefix_applied: Exactly once to all 24 originals, 24 rewrites and 4 controls.

old_response_regression_replay.limitation: The old v2 raw response objects are mapped by item/mode to exact newly generated requests, including recomputed recall prefixes. This checks numeric scoring and local state-machine plumbing only; it does not establish that the model will answer or recall the new prefixed text the same way. Admission is scripted.
